jobs.title: Deployed Architect, Professional Services (Amsterdam)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the Role

We're looking for a Deployed Architect to join our Professional Services team. You'll work directly with enterprise customers to design, deploy, and optimize production-grade AI infrastructure and agent systems. You'll be responsible for architecting scalable, secure infrastructure deployments and building reliable, well-evaluated agent applications that solve real business problems.

This role combines software development, infrastructure/platform engineering, and customer-facing skills. You'll work on everything from Kubernetes cluster design to multi-agent system architecture, requiring deep technical expertise across both infrastructure and agent engineering domains.

This role offers direct impact on customer success, the opportunity to shape best practices, and work with cutting-edge AI technology. You'll join a collaborative team environment with a strong engineering culture.

Location: Netherlands, Amsterdam (Remote with up to 25% travel)

What You'll Do

  • Infrastructure & Platform Engineering: Design scalable, highly-available infrastructure for AI platform deployments (compute, storage, networking, security), enterprise integration patterns, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm), multi-region HA/DR strategies, and CI/CD pipelines

  • Agent Engineering & Development: Design multi-agent systems using different patterns, implement agent logic using modern frameworks (langchain/langgraph), design comprehensive evaluation frameworks, optimize prompts with A/B testing, and guide deployment/operations

  • Customer Engagement & Assessment: Lead technical maturity assessments, work directly with enterprise customers to understand requirements and present recommendations, and partner with Engagement Managers and Product/Engineering teams

What You'll Bring

7+ years of experience in a technical, hands-on customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Deployed Architect or Forward Deployed Engineer. We also like former founders, so if you have an unusual background, but all the right skillsets, you are welcome to apply

Infrastructure & Platform:

  • 3+ years of experience designing and deploying production infrastructure on cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure)

  • Strong Kubernetes experience (GKE, EKS, or AKS) including cluster design, autoscaling, and multi-zone deployments

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm) and GitOps practices

  • Knowledge of database systems (relational databases, in-memory data stores) including HA, replication, backup strategies, and sizing

  • Experience designing high-availability and disaster recovery solutions

  • Strong understanding of networking, security (SSO/RBAC, TLS, secrets management), and observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and applications

Agent Engineering & Development:

  • 1+ years of experience building production AI/ML applications or agents

  • Strong experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, or similar) for building agent-based applications

  • Experience with state management patterns (short-term and long-term memory)

  • Experience designing and implementing evaluation frameworks for AI applications

  • Strong prompt engineering skills with experience in optimization and A/B testing

  • Experience with vector stores, RAG patterns, and knowledge organization

  • Experience with tool integration, API design, and error handling patterns

  • Strong Python and/or TypeScript development skills

Customer-Facing:

  • Customer-facing experience with enterprise customers

  • Experience conducting technical assessments or infrastructure audits

  • Strong communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences

Key Attributes:

  • Strong problem-solving skills with ability to analyze complex requirements and design elegant solutions

  • Excellent customer-facing communication skills, able to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences

  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering teams, product teams, and customers

  • Consultative approach with ability to understand customer needs, provide recommendations, and guide implementation

  • Ability to balance infrastructure architecture with agent development work

  • Strong engineering background with hands-on development experience

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

jobs.title: Deployed Engineer (Atlanta)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the Role

The Deployed Engineering team works directly with companies building and running AI agents in production, helping turn ideas and prototypes into systems teams can rely on.

This is a hands-on, highly technical team that partners closely with customer engineers across the full lifecycle, from pre-sales evaluations to post-deployment advisory work. The focus is on achieving the technical win, co-designing agent architectures, and helping customers operate agents reliably at scale using the LangChain suite.

Deployed Engineers sit at the intersection of engineering, product, and go-to-market, shaping how LangChain is adopted in the field and feeding real-world insights back into the platform

The Deployed Engineer…You’ll work on some of the hardest problems in applied AI — not demos, not research, but systems that real teams depend on in production. The feedback loop is fast, the impact is visible, and the work you do directly shapes how AI agents are built in the real world.

What You’ll Do

  • Co-architect and co-build production AI agents with customer engineering teams

  • Own the technical win in pre-sales by designing POCs, answering deep technical questions, and guiding evaluations

  • Help customers deploy and operate agent-based applications such as conversational agents, research agents, and multi-step workflows

  • Advise customers post-sale on architecture, best practices, and roadmap-level decisions

  • Run technical demos, trainings, and workshops for developer audiences

  • Surface field feedback and contribute reusable patterns, cookbooks, and example code that scale across customers

  • Occasionally contribute code upstream when it meaningfully improves customer outcomes

What You’ll Bring

  • 3+ years in a relevant technical role (software engineering, customer engineering, solutions engineering, founding/product engineering), ideally in a startup or scale-up

  • Strong Python, JavaScript and systems fundamentals

  • Have designed agent-based or LLM-powered applications beyond simple API calls, including multi-step workflows, orchestration, and failure handling

  • Are comfortable working directly with customers during POCs, architecture reviews, and technical evaluations

  • Can explain technical tradeoffs clearly and build trust with developer audiences

  • Take responsibility for outcomes, not just recommendations

  • Have a bias toward action and enjoy figuring things out as you go

  • Are excited about operating AI agents in production, not just building demos

Nice to Have’s:

  • You’ve deployed AI agents in production, especially using LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks

  • Worked with LLM evaluation, observability, or guardrails

  • Have experience with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure), containers, and basic Kubernetes concepts

  • Have shipped and operated production software and are comfortable owning systems under real-world constraints

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

  • Customer Engagement & Assessment: Lead technical maturity assessments, work directly with enterprise customers to understand requirements and present recommendations, and partner with Engagement Managers and Product/Engineering teams

Required Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in a technical, hands-on customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect or Forward Deployed Engineer.

  • Strong Kubernetes experience (GKE, EKS, or AKS) including cluster design, autoscaling, and multi-zone deployments

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm) and GitOps practices

  • Knowledge of database systems (relational databases, in-memory data stores) including HA, replication, backup strategies, and sizing

  • Experience designing high-availability and disaster recovery solutions

  • Strong understanding of networking, security (SSO/RBAC, TLS, secrets management), and observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and applications

Agent Engineering & Development:

  • Strong experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, or similar) for building agent-based applications

  • Experience with state management patterns (short-term and long-term memory)

  • Experience designing and implementing evaluation frameworks for AI applications

  • Strong prompt engineering skills with experience in optimization and A/B testing

  • Experience with vector stores, RAG patterns, and knowledge organization

  • Experience with tool integration, API design, and error handling patterns

  • Strong Python and/or TypeScript development skills

Customer-Facing:

  • Customer-facing experience with enterprise customers

  • Experience conducting technical assessments or infrastructure audits

  • Strong communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences

  • Strong problem-solving skills with ability to analyze complex requirements and design elegant solutions

  • Excellent customer-facing communication skills, able to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences

  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering teams, product teams, and customers

  • Consultative approach with ability to understand customer needs, provide recommendations, and guide implementation

  • Ability to balance infrastructure architecture with agent development work

  • Strong engineering background with hands-on development experience

  • Willing to travel up to 20% of the time

We’re hiring Sales Development Representatives to join our SDR team and help shape the future of how companies adopt LangChain. As part of our SDR team, you’ll turn high inbound interest and targeted outbound demand into qualified opportunities and create an exceptional first-touch experiences for prospects.

You’ll work closely with our Marketing, Sales, and Operations alongside using LangChain and LangGraph-powered agents to automate list building, enrichment, and outreach freeing you to focus entirely on high-impact prospecting and conversations with teams exploring agentic AI.

What makes this role different: You’ll drive pipeline and revenue while learning to leverage AI, automation, and LangChain itself to become a next-generation GTM operator.

What You'll Do

  • Follow up with inbound and outbound prospects via phone, email, and LinkedIn to uncover fit, needs, and potential value.

  • Partner closely with Account Executives to hand off qualified opportunities and ensure a smooth buyer experience.

  • Capture and share insights from conversations to inform our sales plays, product roadmap, and agent development.

  • Experiment with new channels, messaging, and automation to continuously increase conversion and efficiency.

  • Use LangChain powered agents to test, learn, and improve prospecting strategies

What You’ll Bring

  • 1–2 years of experience in a Sales, SDR, or BDR role within SaaS or technology (or strong curiosity and drive if you’re early in your career)

  • Clear, confident communicator who can engage both technical and business audiences

  • Motivated by learning, iteration, and experimentation you treat outreach like a craft

  • Comfortable with a mix of structure and ambiguity you can execute repeatable processes while improving them along the way

jobs.title: Federal Account Executive
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the Role

The LangChain Federal team works directly with U.S. Government customers — including the Department of Defense (DoD), Civilian Agencies, and the Intelligence Community (IC) — who are building and operating AI agents in mission-critical environments. We partner closely with government program managers, technical leads, and system integrators across the full lifecycle, from pre-award shaping and evaluations through post-deployment expansion. We are building the federal go-to-market motion from the ground up, and every team member has a direct hand in shaping how LangChain is adopted across the federal landscape.

We're looking for a Federal Enterprise Account Executive to join our growing GTM team and lead LangChain's expansion into U.S. federal agencies. In this role, you'll own the full sales cycle — helping technical teams at DoD, Civilian, and IC agencies discover, evaluate, and adopt LangChain's products. This is a high-impact, high-visibility role where you'll collaborate closely with engineering, product, solutions engineering, and professional services to shape how AI agent infrastructure gets adopted across government. If you're a relationship-driven seller who understands the federal landscape and wants to be part of building a go-to-market motion from the ground up, we'd love to hear from you.

What You'll Do

  • Own and manage the full federal sales cycle, from lead stage to close with a strong bias for follow-up and follow-through

  • Act as a trusted advisor to federal prospects and customers — including DoD, Civilian Agencies, and IC — learning their mission requirements and demonstrating how LangChain's products solve real problems

  • Drive proof-of-concept efforts, working with solutions engineers and product experts to demonstrate tangible value in government environments

  • Navigate federal procurement mechanisms — GWACs, IDIQs, OTAs, BPAs, and direct agency contracts — to close complex, multi-stakeholder deals with speed and precision

  • Build and maintain trusted relationships with senior agency decision-makers, program managers, and contracting officers, as well as system integrator partners (e.g., Booz Allen, SAIC, Leidos) and resellers (e.g., Carahsoft) who help drive and support deal flow

  • Stay on top of the federal AI landscape — agency priorities, executive orders, budget cycles, and competitor activity — to educate customers and shape LangChain's federal strategy

  • Build long-term customer relationships and support post-sale success in partnership with our Deployed Engineering and support teams

  • Negotiate pricing and deal terms and work with legal to redline contracts

  • Bring federal customer insights back to product and engineering teams to inform the roadmap and improve the user experience

  • Help define and iterate on our federal sales playbook — your input will help shape how we go to market in this segment

What You'll Bring

  • You have 7+ years of experience selling complex software to enterprise or federal customers, with at least 3+ years focused on U.S. federal accounts (DoD, Civilian, and/or IC)

  • You have a proven track record of meeting or exceeding federal revenue targets — ideally $2M+ ARR annually

  • You have deep familiarity with federal procurement: GWACs, IDIQs, OTAs, BPAs, and direct agency contract vehicles

  • You can translate complex technical concepts — LLMs, RAG, agent frameworks, APIs — into mission-aligned value for both technical and non-technical government buyers

  • You have established relationships across federal agencies and the system integrator ecosystem

  • Technical acumen with the ability to establish credibility with technical decision-makers at agencies

  • You thrive in fast-paced start-up environments and are energized by impact — you want to help build the federal playbook, not just follow one

  • Driven and solutions-oriented; you know how to navigate procurement roadblocks and keep complex deals moving forward

  • Passionate about generative AI and excited to help federal customers navigate a rapidly evolving technology landscape

  • You exemplify our operating principles:

    • You are motivated to build something great: you hold a high bar for quality, craft, and impact in every customer interaction and internal deliverable

    • You embrace hot takes: you bring informed opinions about the federal AI market, challenge assumptions, and engage in constructive debate with your team

    • You operate with maximum agency: you take ownership of your territory, move deals forward independently, and help cross-functional partners stay unblocked

    • You run to the roar: you lean into the complexity of government procurement, long deal cycles, and ambiguous buying processes — and find a way through

Nice to Have

  • Active or prior U.S. security clearance (Secret, TS/SCI)

  • Familiarity with LangChain, LangGraph, LangSmith, or similar AI orchestration and observability tools

  • Experience with FedRAMP, DoD Impact Levels (IL2–IL6), or other federal compliance and authorization frameworks

  • Existing relationships with federal-focused system integrators and resellers (e.g., Booz Allen, SAIC, Leidos, Carahsoft)

  • Prior experience building a federal GTM motion at an early-stage or growth-stage company

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the Role

We're looking for a Deployed Architect to join our Professional Services team. You'll work directly with enterprise customers to design, deploy, and optimize production-grade AI infrastructure and agent systems. You'll be responsible for architecting scalable, secure infrastructure deployments and building reliable, well-evaluated agent applications that solve real business problems.

This role combines software development, infrastructure/platform engineering, and customer-facing skills. You'll work on everything from Kubernetes cluster design to multi-agent system architecture, requiring deep technical expertise across both infrastructure and agent engineering domains.

This role offers direct impact on customer success, the opportunity to shape best practices, and work with cutting-edge AI technology. You'll join a collaborative team environment with a strong engineering culture.

Location: Remote

What You'll Do

  • Infrastructure & Platform Engineering: Design scalable, highly-available infrastructure for AI platform deployments (compute, storage, networking, security), enterprise integration patterns, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm), multi-region HA/DR strategies, and CI/CD pipelines

  • Agent Engineering & Development: Design multi-agent systems using different patterns, implement agent logic using modern frameworks (langchain/langgraph), design comprehensive evaluation frameworks, optimize prompts with A/B testing, and guide deployment/operations

  • Customer Engagement & Assessment: Lead technical maturity assessments, work directly with enterprise customers to understand requirements and present recommendations, and partner with Engagement Managers and Product/Engineering teams

 

What You'll Bring

Required Experience

  • 7+ years of experience in a technical, hands-on customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect or Forward Deployed Engineer.

  • We also like former founders, so if you have an unusual background, but all the right skillsets, you are welcome to apply

Infrastructure & Platform:

  • 3+ years of experience designing and deploying production infrastructure on cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, or Azure)

  • Strong Kubernetes experience (GKE, EKS, or AKS) including cluster design, autoscaling, and multi-zone deployments

  • Experience with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Helm) and GitOps practices

  • Knowledge of database systems (relational databases, in-memory data stores) including HA, replication, backup strategies, and sizing

  • Experience designing high-availability and disaster recovery solutions

  • Strong understanding of networking, security (SSO/RBAC, TLS, secrets management), and observability (Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog)

  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines for infrastructure and applications

Agent Engineering & Development:

  • 1+ years of experience building production AI/ML applications or agents

  • Strong experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, LangGraph, or similar) for building agent-based applications

  • Experience with state management patterns (short-term and long-term memory)

  • Experience designing and implementing evaluation frameworks for AI applications

  • Strong prompt engineering skills with experience in optimization and A/B testing

  • Experience with vector stores, RAG patterns, and knowledge organization

  • Experience with tool integration, API design, and error handling patterns

  • Strong Python and/or TypeScript development skills

Customer-Facing:

  • Customer-facing experience with enterprise customers

  • Experience conducting technical assessments or infrastructure audits

  • Strong communication skills with ability to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences

Key Attributes

  • Strong problem-solving skills with ability to analyze complex requirements and design elegant solutions

  • Excellent customer-facing communication skills, able to explain technical concepts to diverse audiences

  • Experience working cross-functionally with engineering teams, product teams, and customers

  • Consultative approach with ability to understand customer needs, provide recommendations, and guide implementation

  • Ability to balance infrastructure architecture with agent development work

  • Strong engineering background with hands-on development experience

  • Willing to travel up to 20% of the time

 
Looking to lead technical strategy across the customer journey from Proofs of Value (PoVs) to driving overall adoption? Please check out the Deployed Engineer listing focused on Account Strategy & Solutions.
 

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

Location: US West Coast

  • Manage the entire customer lifecycle post signature for a portfolio of commercial customers, from adoption to contract execution, ensuring high retention rates.

  • Develop and maintain a rolling forecast of your portfolio and consistently meet or exceed quarterly and annual renewal and net retention targets.

  • Proactively identify and mitigate churn risk by understanding customer health, monitoring product usage, and addressing commercial obstacles.

  • Uncover and execute on expansion opportunities by understanding customer needs, aligning them with new features and products, and articulating the incremental value.

  • Build and nurture lasting relationships with key stakeholders, from technical users to economic buyers.

  • Act as the voice of the customer, synthesizing feedback on value, product gaps, and business outcomes to inform the product roadmap and collaborate with Product and Engineering teams.

  • Partner closely with Sales, GTM Engineering, and RevOps teams to present a unified post-sale experience and ensure a seamless customer journey.

  • Lead commercial negotiations, structure renewal contracts, and manage quoting and procurement processes to ensure favorable terms for both the customer and LangChain.

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in a quota-carrying, customer-facing role such as Account Management, Customer Success, or Renewals Manager, preferably within B2B SaaS.

  • A proven track record of success in meeting and exceeding retention and expansion quotas (e.g., Gross Renewal Rate, Net Revenue Retention).

  • Strong commercial acumen and negotiation skills, with experience managing complex, multi-stakeholder renewal cycles.

  • Strong technical aptitude and the ability to understand and articulate the value of complex technical products. Familiarity with the modern AI/LLM stack is a significant plus.

  • Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to build rapport and convey value to diverse audiences, from technical users to executive decision-makers.

  • A deep empathy for the customer's business objectives and a passion for helping them achieve their goals through our platform.

  • Proficiency with CRM software (e.g., Salesforce) for pipeline management and forecasting.

  • Ability to operate independently with a high degree of autonomy in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment.

  • Direct experience at a high-growth, developer-first, or AI/ML infrastructure company.

  • Experience managing renewals in a consumption or usage-based pricing model.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role where you’ll collaborate closely with engineering, product, and customer success teams to shape how GenAI is adopted across different domains. If you're a relationship-driven seller who thrives in fast-paced, unstructured environments and wants to be part of building the go-to-market motion from the ground up, we’d love to hear from you.

Location: UK

What You’ll Do

  • Own and manage the full sales cycle, from lead stage to close with a strong bias for follow-up and follow-through

  • Act as a trusted advisor to prospects and customers, learning their needs and demonstrating how our products can solve real problems

  • Drive proof-of-concept efforts, working with sales engineers and product experts to demonstrate tangible value

  • Stay on top of product updates and industry trends to educate customers and shape the conversation around GenAI adoption

  • Build long-term customer relationships and support post-sale success in partnership with our deployment and support teams

  • Negotiate pricing and deal terms and work with legal to redline contracts

  • Bring customer insights back to product and engineering teams to inform the future roadmap and improve the user experience

  • Help define and iterate on our sales playbook - your input will help shape our go to market strategies

  • Native French Speaker

jobs.title: Deployed Engineer (Seattle)
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the Role

The Deployed Engineering team works directly with companies building and running AI agents in production, helping turn ideas and prototypes into systems teams can rely on.

This is a hands-on, highly technical team that partners closely with customer engineers across the full lifecycle, from pre-sales evaluations to post-deployment advisory work. The focus is on achieving the technical win, co-designing agent architectures, and helping customers operate agents reliably at scale using the LangChain suite.

Deployed Engineers sit at the intersection of engineering, product, and go-to-market, shaping how LangChain is adopted in the field and feeding real-world insights back into the platform.

The Deployed Engineer…You’ll work on some of the hardest problems in applied AI — not demos, not research, but systems that real teams depend on in production. The feedback loop is fast, the impact is visible, and the work you do directly shapes how AI agents are built in the real world.

What You’ll Do

  • Co-architect and co-build production AI agents with customer engineering teams

  • Own the technical win in pre-sales by designing POCs, answering deep technical questions, and guiding evaluations

  • Help customers deploy and operate agent-based applications such as conversational agents, research agents, and multi-step workflows

  • Advise customers post-sale on architecture, best practices, and roadmap-level decisions

  • Run technical demos, trainings, and workshops for developer audiences

  • Surface field feedback and contribute reusable patterns, cookbooks, and example code that scale across customers

  • Occasionally contribute code upstream when it meaningfully improves customer outcomes

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years in a relevant technical role (software engineering, customer engineering, solutions engineering, founding/product engineering), ideally in a startup or scale-up

  • Strong Python, JavaScript and systems fundamentals

  • Have designed agent-based or LLM-powered applications beyond simple API calls, including multi-step workflows, orchestration, and failure handling

  • Are comfortable working directly with customers during POCs, architecture reviews, and technical evaluations

  • Can explain technical tradeoffs clearly and build trust with developer audiences

  • Take responsibility for outcomes, not just recommendations

  • Have a bias toward action and enjoy figuring things out as you go

  • Are excited about operating AI agents in production, not just building demos

Nice to Have’s:

  • You’ve deployed AI agents in production, especially using LangChain, LangGraph, or similar frameworks

  • Worked with LLM evaluation, observability, or guardrails

  • Have experience with cloud environments (AWS, GCP, Azure), containers, and basic Kubernetes concepts

  • Have shipped and operated production software and are comfortable owning systems under real-world constraints

Looking for a hands-on implementation role focused on custom delivery, bespoke integrations, and scoped consulting projects? Please check out the Deployed Engineer (Professional Services) roles.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

jobs.title: Head of Narratives
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the Role

LangChain has strong technical credibility, a large developer community, and a lot worth saying. What we need now is someone to make sure we're saying it — consistently, strategically, and in ways that land.

We're looking for a Head of Narratives to own how LangChain shows up in the world across communications, brand, social, and design. This is a role for someone who thinks like a media company operator: always-on publishing, sharp editorial judgment, a clear point of view on the themes that matter, and a relentless focus on getting great narratives in front of the right people at the right time.

You'll lead an existing team of rockstars across brand, social, and design — each with deep expertise. Your job is to give the team a shared narrative direction, keep the output sharp and consistent, and make sure LangChain is building an audience that wants to hear from us.

This is a player-coach role. You'll set the direction but you'll also be in the work — shaping editorial, giving creative feedback, and reviewing and writing. The right person is opinionated about what good looks like and hands-on enough to help get there.

 

What You'll Do

Communications

  • Define the themes and narratives LangChain is hitting. Spearhead the direction on what LangChain should be known for and translate that into a rolling communications strategy the whole team is working from. This is the backbone of everything else.

  • Own press and media relations. Kickstart our comms efforts, building and managing relationships with key journalists and outlets, drive proactive press coverage, and act as the point of contact for inbound media inquiries.

  • Shape executive visibility and thought leadership. Identify the moments, platforms, and formats where LangChain's leaders should have a voice, and help them show up with a clear, consistent point of view.

  • Lead announcement strategy. Plan and execute communications around major launches, funding, partnerships, and company milestones, working cross-functionally to make sure the story lands with the right audiences at the right time.

  • Set and uphold the communications standard. Define LangChain's voice in the outside world and the quality bar for anything that goes out under its name.

Brand

  • Shape brand direction in close partnership with the brand lead. The brand lead focuses on brand voice, visual identity, and standards. You'll work closely together to align on where the brand is headed, what it stands for, and how it shows up — with narrative and brand informing each other rather than operating separately.

  • Stay close to major brand moments. Bring a point of view on concept and messaging for out-of-home, awareness campaigns, and other brand initiatives. Work with the brand lead to make sure what we're saying and how we're showing up are pulling in the same direction.

  • Make sure brand and narrative feel like one thing. The brand should feel like a natural extension of the editorial point of view, and vice versa.

Social & Rich Media

  • Partner with the social lead on strategy, themes, and goals. The social lead focuses on growing LangChain's social channels and ways to amplify our content and messaging. Work together to ensure social is amplifying the themes and narratives the broader team is driving.

  • Shape LangChain's rich media approach together. Work with the social lead to develop a shared point of view on how video, audio, and other formats fit into the content mix — where they build audience, where they deepen credibility, and how to build the right execution muscle over time.

  • Track what's working, what's not, and use it to sharpen direction. Stay close to performance across content, comms, brand, and social to have a better sense on where to focus, what narratives are resonating, and where to double down.

Brand Design

  • Lead the creative direction for brand design in close partnership with our brand designer. Own the visual vision for how LangChain looks and feels — and work day-to-day with our brand designer to translate that into execution across campaigns, content, comms, social, and brand moments.

  • Be a strong creative partner. Have a real point of view on what looks right, what earns trust with a technical audience, and where the work needs to go further. Give clear direction and help the designer do their best work.

  • Keep visual identity consistent across every channel. A media company looks like itself everywhere it shows up. Make sure LangChain does too.

Team Leadership

  • Lead by being in it. Develop your team by being close to the work — giving useful feedback, shaping output, and raising the bar through example.

  • Build the operating rhythm. Establish the rituals and shared workflows — editorial planning, cross-functional reviews, publishing cadences — that help brand, social, comms, and design operate as a unit.

  • Connect narrative to the rest of the business. Translate what marketing, sales, product, and leadership need into a narrative strategy your team can execute — and keep everyone aligned as priorities shift.

 

What You'll Bring

  • Ability to work like a media company operator. You think in publishing cadences, audience development, and narrative arcs — not just campaigns. You know what it takes to build an always-on narrative engine and keep it running at a high standard.

  • Player-coach. You've led creative, comms, or content teams and know how to develop people — but you stay close to the work and make it better by being in it.

  • Strong narrative instincts. You have a clear point of view on what makes a brand story work and can translate that into real direction across comms, brand, social, and design.

  • Analytically grounded. You track what's working, form a view on why, and use that to make better decisions about where to focus. You connect creative work to business outcomes.

  • Developer audience instincts. You understand what earns trust with technical audiences and can orient a creative team around that bar.

  • Collaborative and clear. You work well with strong practitioners who own their domains — building alignment without stepping on what they own.

Nice to Have

  • Experience leading narrative, brand, or comms teams at a developer-focused company

  • Background in technical or developer marketing

  • Familiarity with the AI/ML ecosystem and the tools developers use to build

  • Track record running brand campaigns, including out-of-home or awareness programs

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

 - Set and uphold the communications standard. Define LangChain's voice in the outside world and the quality bar for anything that goes out under its name.


BRAND

 - Shape brand direction in close partnership with the brand lead. The brand lead focuses on brand voice, visual identity, and standards. You'll work closely together to align on where the brand is headed, what it stands for, and how it shows up — with narrative and brand informing each other rather than operating separately.

 - Stay close to major brand moments. Bring a point of view on concept and messaging for out-of-home, awareness campaigns, and other brand initiatives. Work with the brand lead to make sure what we're saying and how we're showing up are pulling in the same direction.

 - Make sure brand and narrative feel like one thing. The brand should feel like a natural extension of the editorial point of view, and vice versa.


SOCIAL & RICH MEDIA

 - Partner with the social lead on strategy, themes, and goals. The social lead focuses on growing LangChain's social channels and ways to amplify our content and messaging. Work together to ensure social is amplifying the themes and narratives the broader team is driving.

 - Shape LangChain's rich media approach together. Work with the social lead to develop a shared point of view on how video, audio, and other formats fit into the content mix — where they build audience, where they deepen credibility, and how to build the right execution muscle over time.

 - Track what's working, what's not, and use it to sharpen direction. Stay close to performance across content, comms, brand, and social to have a better sense on where to focus, what narratives are resonating, and where to double down.


BRAND DESIGN

 - Lead the creative direction for brand design in close partnership with our brand designer. Own the visual vision for how LangChain looks and feels — and work day-to-day with our brand designer to translate that into execution across campaigns, content, comms,  social, and brand moments.

 - Be a strong creative partner. Have a real point of view on what looks right, what earns trust with a technical audience, and where the work needs to go further. Give clear direction and help the designer do their best work.

 - Keep visual identity consistent across every channel. A media company looks like itself everywhere it shows up. Make sure LangChain does too.


TEAM LEADERSHIP

 - Lead by being in it. Develop your team by being close to the work — giving useful feedback, shaping output, and raising the bar through example.

 - Build the operating rhythm. Establish the rituals and shared workflows — editorial planning, cross-functional reviews, publishing cadences — that help brand, social, comms, and design operate as a unit.

 - Connect narrative to the rest of the business. Translate what marketing, sales, product, and leadership need into a narrative strategy your team can execute — and keep everyone aligned as priorities shift.

 


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - Ability to work like a media company operator. You think in publishing cadences, audience development, and narrative arcs — not just campaigns. You know what it takes to build an always-on narrative engine and keep it running at a high standard.

 - Player-coach. You've led creative, comms, or content teams and know how to develop people — but you stay close to the work and make it better by being in it.

 - Strong narrative instincts. You have a clear point of view on what makes a brand story work and can translate that into real direction across comms, brand, social, and design.

 - Analytically grounded. You track what's working, form a view on why, and use that to make better decisions about where to focus. You connect creative work to business outcomes.

 - Developer audience instincts. You understand what earns trust with technical audiences and can orient a creative team around that bar.

 - Collaborative and clear. You work well with strong practitioners who own their domains — building alignment without stepping on what they own.


NICE TO HAVE 

 - Experience leading narrative, brand, or comms teams at a developer-focused company

 - Background in technical or developer marketing

 - Familiarity with the AI/ML ecosystem and the tools developers use to build

 - Track record running brand campaigns, including out-of-home or awareness programs




COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. 

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.




BENEFITS

jobs.title: Partner Alliance Lead, Federal
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the Role

As our first Federal Partner Alliances Lead for the US, you will own the systems integrator and consulting partner ecosystem across the US Federal market. This is a high-leverage, senior individual contributor role where you will build and drive our federal partner strategy from the ground up — focused primarily on establishing deep, revenue-generating relationships with the major Federal Systems Integrators (FSIs) and a curated set of specialized boutique partners.

You are an operator at heart who loves the ambiguity of a fast-growing startup. You understand how developer tools and enterprise AI stacks fit together within the unique compliance and regulatory requirements of the federal space, and you have a track record of driving sourced and influenced revenue through partner channels without needing a heavy management playbook to guide you. This role sits within our GTM organization and will work closely with our field sellers, customer engineering teams, and product leaders to embed LangChain into the delivery practices and solution portfolios of the partners who win and execute the biggest federal AI programs.

What You'll Do

  • Own FSI Relationships: Build and lead LangChain's strategic partnerships with the major federal primes — including Leidos, Booz Allen Hamilton, Northrop Grumman, SAIC, Accenture Federal, and similar large-scale integrators. Drive structured engagement across their AI/ML practices, solution architects, and business development teams to embed LangChain into active and upcoming program pursuits.

  • Develop Boutique and Specialized Partners: Identify and activate a curated set of smaller, mission-focused federal consultancies and AI-native partners that are embedded in specific agency relationships or cleared environments where the primes don't reach.

  • Build Joint Go-to-Market Motions: Work with FSI partners to co-develop solution offerings, reference architectures, and proposal language that positions LangChain as the preferred agentic AI framework for federal program delivery.

  • Drive Pipeline Through Partners: Own the partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, working hand-in-hand with LangChain's field sales team to ensure FSI relationships translate into real opportunities and closed revenue.

  • Support Hyperscaler Relationships Selectively: Maintain a lightweight working relationship with AWS GovCloud, Azure Government, and GCP Public Sector teams, primarily to support event sponsorships, joint visibility opportunities, and marketplace presence — without making this a primary focus of the role.

  • Execute Co-Marketing Motions: Partner with marketing to show up effectively at key federal industry events (AFCEA, AWS Summit DC, industry days) and develop technical content and co-branded materials that reinforce LangChain's credibility with FSI and agency audiences.

  • Build the Playbook: Create the operational blueprint for how LangChain scales federal partnerships — from initial relationship mapping and partner tiering to joint pipeline tracking and executive engagement cadences.

What You'll Bring

  • Experience: 6+ years of experience in federal partner management, business development, or alliance roles, with a strong track record of building and monetizing relationships with major FSIs and federal primes. Direct experience working within or alongside Leidos, Booz Allen Hamilton, Northrop Grumman, SAIC, or similar organizations is a significant plus.

  • FSI Network: A genuine, pre-existing network within the business development, AI/ML practice, and solutions architecture communities at the major federal primes. You should be able to get meetings quickly and have credibility with the people who shape program pursuit decisions.

  • Technical Foundation: Enough technical fluency to speak credibly with enterprise architects and engineering leads in federal environments. You don't need to write code, but you must understand how LLMs, agentic frameworks, and developer tooling operate within federal infrastructure, including FedRAMP, IL4/IL5, and zero-trust requirements.

  • Startup Agility: Proven ability to navigate a high-growth environment with limited structure. You are comfortable building the playbook as you run it, executing independently with minimal supervision in the often long-cycle federal sales environment.

  • Operational Rigor: Strong pipeline management skills. You track partner activity with clean CRM hygiene, maintain accurate opportunity attribution, and communicate clearly and consistently to internal stakeholders.

  • Strong Communication & Influence: Equally comfortable writing sharp internal strategy docs as you are presenting to senior BD and practice leaders at major federal integrators.

Nice to Have's

  • Active security clearance (Secret or higher) or existing clearance eligibility.

  • Prior experience at an open-source, developer tools, or infrastructure software company bringing a new technology into the federal FSI ecosystem.

  • Familiarity with federal procurement vehicles (GSA Schedule, OTAs, BPAs) and how primes use them to structure program delivery.

  • Familiarity with the modern LLM orchestration stack, federal data environments, and compliance frameworks (FedRAMP, NIST, CMMC).

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. About the Role

We're hiring our first Demand Generation Lead for EMEA, Middle East and Emerging Markets. You'll own how LangSmith shows up in the region and how that turns into pipeline from partnering with performance marketing, lifecycle marketing, integrated campaigns and webinars to build a localized campaigns.

You'll be deciding what works in the region, run the experiments to prove it, and then scale what works into a repeatable regional playbook. You’ll be a builder with central support from our US demand gen, product marketing, and marketing ops teams.

Location: UK, London or The Netherlands, Amsterdam

What You'll Do

Regional demand strategy and pipeline:

  • Build the EMEA demand plan: which markets, which segments, which channels, and what each is expected to return

  • Own an EMEA pipeline target and report against it sourced and influenced, by channel and by market

  • Decide how the regional demand budget gets allocated for localized programs.

Full-funnel program execution:

You'll own the whole mix for the region and be hands-on in all of it:

  • Paid digital: partner with performance marketing to support localized 3rd party promotion, paid search, paid social, and retargeting strategy, including account-level and contact-level targeting to give sellers air cover in named accounts

  • Webinars: run a regional cadence across live demos, thought leadership webinars, technical workshops, and customer stories, in local time zones with local speakers where it helps

  • Integrated campaigns: adapt global LangSmith narratives and build region-first campaigns when the market needs something different

  • Lifecycle: build segmented nurtures and post-event follow-up for regional leads, with attention to language and time zone.

Cross-functional partnership:

  • Work directly with EMEA AEs and SDRs to understand what converts in-region and co-design follow-up plays that drive pipeline.

  • Partner closely with Field Marketing to build joint regional plans, align priorities, and create a coordinated interface into the sales team.

  • Support new-hire ramp by identifying warm signals, share campaign hand-off details, marketing programs, and proven outreach plays reps can use in their first 90 days.

  • Collaborate with RevOps on targeting, routing, campaign tracking, and reporting to improve regional execution and pipeline visibility.

What You'll Bring

  • 7+ years in B2B demand generation, growth marketing, or integrated campaigns, ideally in developer tools, infrastructure, or technical SaaS

  • Track record of building demand programs in EMEA across multiple countries, with a clear view of where localization matters and where it doesn't

  • You've personally run paid, webinars, lifecycle, and ABM

  • You write the copy, build the landing page, pull the report, and launch the campaign

  • Comfortable with a technical product and a technical audience. You don't need to write code, but you should be able to hold a conversation about agents, evals, and observability without a script

  • Strong partner to Sales. You've worked shoulder to shoulder with AEs and SDRs and you're comfortable with a pipeline number

  • Fluent in the numbers: funnel conversion, CPL, cost per SQO, pipeline contribution, and attribution's real limits

  • Working command of a modern stack, Hubspot, Influ2, Qualified, Goldcast, Zoom Webinar, Zapier, SFDC, Reo.dev, and Clay

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and true ownership

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the Role

We are seeking our second IT Engineer to join our growing team in San Francisco. Our team laid the foundation for IT at LangChain, and this role is critical to helping us mature and scale that foundation as the company grows. You'll bring deep technical expertise to our fleet management and SaaS administration, with room to shape how we manage our fleet, identity, SaaS stack, and the automation that runs the business. The ideal candidate brings startup experience, thrives in ambiguity, loves a good problem, and is excited to build scalable systems that support our global team. This role can be worked out of SF or NYC.

 

What You'll Do

Infrastructure & Automation

  • Build and maintain our IT infrastructure and tech stack that scales with LangChain’s rapid growth

  • Drive automation initiatives to reduce toil and improve efficiency using scripts, APIs, and workflow tools

  • Implement monitoring and documentation practices that enable operational excellence

Client Platform Engineering

  • Reimagine how we deploy, configure, and manage our Mac fleet. MDM (Iru) is the foundation, not the entire solution however.

  • Design and build a secure, reliable, and maintainable desktop environment that replaces our current patchwork of one-off scripts with version-controlled, testable, and repeatable systems

  • Own our approach to custom security controls and application deployment across the fleet, so updates and configuration changes are consistent and easy to roll out at scale

  • Build the fleet management systems now so they hold up as headcount, and the fleet, keep growing

Security & Identity Management

  • Drive our identity strategy, implementing secure, scalable access controls following the principle of least privilege

  • Identify and implement security enhancements across our SaaS stack

  • Partner with our Security team to drive improvement of our enterprise security posture

SaaS Administration

  • Administer and optimize our growing SaaS stack, managing provisioning, access controls, and lifecycle management

  • Become IT's central administrator for LangSmith, our own product, developing deep fluency in its administration surface

  • Build automated workflows for LangSmith administration using its API paired with our automation tooling, reducing manual, toil-heavy admin work

  • Help IT stay fluent across the internal tools we run and support, including the LLM Gateway. Another LangChain product.

Core IT Operations

  • Provide support to employees globally across hardware, software, networking, and IT tools

  • Deliver great onboarding experiences for new hires, ensuring they have the right hardware, access, and setup so they can be productive from day one

     

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience in IT engineering and systems administration

  • Deep proficiency with Okta and Okta Workflows

  • Fluency in at least one general-purpose programming language (Python, JavaScript, or similar) with demonstrated ability to write production-quality scripts and automation

  • Versed in the us of REST APIs, webhooks, and API authentication methods; you should be comfortable reading API documentation and building integrations between systems

  • Demonstrated ability to build meaningful automations that reduce manual work and improve IT operations

  • Hands-on experience with IaC using Terraform to manage and provision IT infrastructure and applications, and comfort applying changes within an existing Terraform codebase

  • Experience using coding agents (e.g. Claude Code) as part of your day-to-day engineering workflow to build and ship automation faster

  • Strong experience with a modern tech stack that includes Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Claude, ChatGPT

  • Solid understanding of MDM platforms, and ideally experience going beyond baseline MDM with fleet/configuration management tooling to manage a fleet's security and application needs

  • Experience administering a large or complex SaaS stack, ideally including internal or AI/LLM-based products

  • Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, firewalls, switching, wireless, LAN/WAN)

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

You'll bring deep technical expertise to our fleet management and SaaS administration, with room to shape how we manage our fleet, identity, SaaS stack, and the automation that runs the business. The ideal candidate brings startup experience, thrives in ambiguity, loves a good problem, and is excited to build scalable systems that support our global team. This role can be worked out of SF or NYC.

 


WHAT YOU'LL DO

Infrastructure & Automation

 - Build and maintain our IT infrastructure and tech stack that scales with LangChain’s rapid growth

 - Drive automation initiatives to reduce toil and improve efficiency using scripts, APIs, and workflow tools

 - Implement monitoring and documentation practices that enable operational excellence

Client Platform Engineering

 - Reimagine how we deploy, configure, and manage our Mac fleet. MDM (Iru) is the foundation, not the entire solution however.

 - Design and build a secure, reliable, and maintainable desktop environment that replaces our current patchwork of one-off scripts with version-controlled, testable, and repeatable systems

 - Own our approach to custom security controls and application deployment across the fleet, so updates and configuration changes are consistent and easy to roll out at scale

 - Build the fleet management systems now so they hold up as headcount, and the fleet, keep growing

Security & Identity Management

 - Drive our identity strategy, implementing secure, scalable access controls following the principle of least privilege

 - Identify and implement security enhancements across our SaaS stack

 - Partner with our Security team to drive improvement of our enterprise security posture

SaaS Administration

 - Administer and optimize our growing SaaS stack, managing provisioning, access controls, and lifecycle management

 - Become IT's central administrator for LangSmith, our own product, developing deep fluency in its administration surface

 - Build automated workflows for LangSmith administration using its API paired with our automation tooling, reducing manual, toil-heavy admin work

 - Help IT stay fluent across the internal tools we run and support, including the LLM Gateway. Another LangChain product.

Core IT Operations

 - Provide support to employees globally across hardware, software, networking, and IT tools

 - Deliver great onboarding experiences for new hires, ensuring they have the right hardware, access, and setup so they can be productive from day one
   
    


WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 5+ years of experience in IT engineering and systems administration

 - Deep proficiency with Okta and Okta Workflows

 - Fluency in at least one general-purpose programming language (Python, JavaScript, or similar) with demonstrated ability to write production-quality scripts and automation

 - Versed in the us of REST APIs, webhooks, and API authentication methods; you should be comfortable reading API documentation and building integrations between systems

 - Demonstrated ability to build meaningful automations that reduce manual work and improve IT operations

 - Hands-on experience with IaC using Terraform to manage and provision IT infrastructure and applications, and comfort applying changes within an existing Terraform codebase

 - Experience using coding agents (e.g. Claude Code) as part of your day-to-day engineering workflow to build and ship automation faster

 - Strong experience with a modern tech stack that includes Google Workspace, Slack, Notion, Claude, ChatGPT

 - Solid understanding of MDM platforms, and ideally experience going beyond baseline MDM with fleet/configuration management tooling to manage a fleet's security and application needs

 - Experience administering a large or complex SaaS stack, ideally including internal or AI/LLM-based products

 - Strong networking fundamentals (TCP/IP, DNS, VPNs, firewalls, switching, wireless, LAN/WAN)




COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. 

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.




BENEFITS

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About The Role

We're looking for a Product Designer to help shape the experience for the developers and teams who build on LangChain. You'll work across our core product surfaces, and depending on where the need is greatest, that could include how developers get from first signup to real production usage, as well as deeper platform workflows like debugging, evaluation, and observability.

The common thread is developers doing technical, often high-stakes work, and needing an interface that gets out of their way. You'll partner with engineering, product, and other designers to figure out where the friction is and design your way out of it.

*This position will be onsite in San Francisco, CA

What You'll Do

  • Build a deep understanding of how developers actually use LangChain's products through interviews and feedback sessions so your design decisions are grounded in real behavior and address user needs

  • Own the full design arc on your features — from early concepts to polished, shipped work

  • Work across a range of product areas and design initiatives as priorities shift

  • Collaborate closely with product, engineering and other key stakeholders to ship new features quickly

What You'll Bring

  • 3+ years of fullstack product design experience ideally working on developer tools, AI, or complex SaaS products

  • Sharp eye for detail, with a strong foundation across user-centered design, interaction design, and visual craft

  • A track record of solving hard interaction design problems, particularly around dense technical data

  • Data-driven decision making - you are comfortable driving user research, both with internal stakeholders and external customers, and using what you learn to inform your designs

  • You take initiative and ownership of tasks end-to-end

  • Strong technical acumen - you collaborate effectively with engineers to design things that are both well-crafted and feasible

  • Start-up DNA - you thrive in fast-paced, highly dynamic environments

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

This is a high-impact, high-visibility role where you’ll collaborate closely with engineering, product, and customer success teams to shape how GenAI is adopted across different domains. What You’ll Do

  • Own and manage the full sales cycle, from lead stage to close with a strong bias for follow-up and follow-through

  • Stay on top of product updates and industry trends to educate customers and shape the conversation around GenAI adoption

  • Build long-term customer relationships and support post-sale success in partnership with our deployment and support teams

  • Negotiate pricing and deal terms and work with legal to redline contracts

  • Bring customer insights back to product and engineering teams to inform the future roadmap and improve the user experience

  • Help define and iterate on our sales playbook - your input will help shape our go to market strategies

What You'll Bring

  • 5+ years of experience selling complex software to enterprise customers

  • A relationship builder that garners trust quickly and approaches sales with empathy and curiosity
