jobs.title: Revenue Manager
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the Role

We're hiring our first Revenue Manager to own revenue accounting end to end: how we recognize it, how we close it, and the systems that produce it. You'll report to our Controller and work closely with rev ops, sales, legal, and FP&A.

We sell through self-serve, enterprise contracts, and on marketplaces, with a mix of subscription, consumption, and self-hosted pricing as well as professional services. That mix makes revenue interesting. Prepaid credits, commits, overages, and multi-element deals all need clear policy and systems that get them right every month.

This is a hands-on role. You'll write the accounting memos and also own how Salesforce, Metronome, and our ERP fit together so the numbers tie without a spreadsheet in the middle. We want someone who leans into AI. You'll use AI tools and agents to automate reconciliations, draft memos, and review contracts, and you'll help set how the rest of the accounting team works with them.

What You'll Do

Revenue recognition and policy

  • Own ASC 606 for every way we sell: subscription, consumption, self-hosted licenses, and marketplace

  • Write and maintain technical accounting memos and our revenue policy

  • Build and maintain our standalone selling price (SSP) analysis and run allocations on multi-element deals

  • Set the treatment for prepaid credits, commits, rollover, overages, breakage, and promotional credits

  • Set revenue positions for new AI and consumption products, and track partner and marketplace economics as those models evolve

  • Review deals before signature and advise sales and rev ops on how terms affect revenue

Close and reporting

  • Run the monthly revenue close: usage revenue, deferred revenue, contract assets, and unbilled AR, with rollforwards and reconciliations

  • Reconcile usage data, Metronome, Salesforce, and the GL every month

  • Own the allowance for credit losses, from methodology through the audit memo, with collections and sales

  • Produce revenue and deferred revenue flux analysis, RPO, and disaggregation, and present results in quarterly close reviews

  • Partner with FP&A to tie ARR and usage metrics to GAAP revenue

  • Own commission capitalization under ASC 340-40

  • Support special projects like new pricing launches and products

Systems

  • Own the revenue data flow from Salesforce to Metronome to our ERP and revenue subledger

  • Design revenue rules and configuration in our AI-native ERP, and review its output rather than rebuild it in spreadsheets

  • Lead requirements, testing, and parallel runs for new systems, products, and pricing launches

  • Build automated reconciliations, controls, and AI agents so the close scales with the business

Audit and controls

  • Own revenue for the annual audit: PBCs, memos, and walkthroughs

  • Design revenue controls that would hold up to a SOX-level review

What You'll Bring

  • 6 to 9 years of accounting experience, including 2+ years in public accounting (Big 4 or national firm) with technology clients

  • 3+ years owning revenue accounting in-house at a high-growth software company, ideally with usage- or consumption-based pricing

  • CPA preferred

  • Deep, hands-on ASC 606 knowledge, including complex and non-standard arrangements: you've written the memos, built an SSP analysis, and defended your conclusions to auditors

  • Business ownership of at least one revenue or billing system implementation, from requirements and data mapping through testing, parallel runs, and go-live

  • A track record of replacing a manual process with an automated one

  • Experience closing revenue under audit at a pre-IPO or public company

  • You lean into AI. You already use AI tools or agents in your own work, can show where they made your close faster or more accurate, and want to build a revenue function that runs AI-first

  • Clear writing and judgment. You can explain a revenue conclusion to a sales leader in two sentences and to an auditor in two pages

Nice to Have

  • Experience with Metronome, Stripe Billing, or a similar usage-billing platform

  • Experience with AI-native or modern ERPs, or NetSuite ARM, Zuora Revenue, or RightRev

  • Accounting for self-hosted or on-prem software licenses alongside SaaS

  • Cloud marketplace sales (AWS, GCP, Azure), including private offers

  • IPO readiness or first-year SOX experience

  • Experience at an AI, developer tools, or infrastructure company

  • Built a revenue function or close process from scratch

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the Role

The Security team ensures that while AI moves at breakneck speed, everyone driving the racecar is wearing a seatbelt. We secure LangChain's core platform and protect AI agents from emerging threats. We work across the stack so developers can confidently ship from prototype to production without compromising on safety or privacy. You'll be a hands-on security engineer working with product teams to secure agentic workloads across our SDKs, LangSmith and LangGraph services, and customer integrations.

What You’ll Do

  • You'll ship secure designs and code, improve authentication and tenant isolation, and help teams address vulnerabilities and infrastructure risks.

  • You’ll work on security problems that don’t have an established playbook. The scope depends on what you bring. You might:

    • Own a high-risk surface like authentication or tenant isolation and fix it end to end.

    • Set direction for a larger security initiative across our SDKs, LangSmith, and LangGraph.

    • Define how we design and secure agentic products across the company.

 

What You’ll Bring

  • 5+ years in security engineering with strong software skills (Python or Go; TypeScript a plus).

  • Depth in cloud/Kubernetes security (e.g., GCP/AWS IAM, workload identity, admission controls, network policies).

  • Hands‑on AppSec: code review, threat modeling, secure design, secrets & key management, authn/z patterns, multi‑tenant isolation.

  • Experience building detection & response and running incident management.

  • Familiarity with supply‑chain security (SBOM, sigstore/cosign, SLSA‑style controls) and dependency risk management.

  • Clear, pragmatic communication with engineers and customers.

Nice to Have's

  • Security for SaaS + self‑hosted offerings, including air‑gapped deployments.

  • Exposure to SOC 2 / ISO 27001 programs and evidence automation.

  • Experience with Go services and Infra as Code (Terraform/Helm), plus policy‑as‑code (OPA/Gatekeeper/Kyverno).

  • Knowledge of privacy patterns (data minimization, retention, masking, workspace scoping)..

     

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

We’re hiring a Technical Support Engineer to lead our customer support experience for highly technical users, from AI engineers to infrastructure architects. You’ll be on the front lines helping teams debug production LLM applications and agents, improve AI observability and evaluations, and unblock critical issues. You’ll also help define what world-class technical support looks like for modern AI platforms

What You'll Do

  • Be the go-to escalation point for technical support inquiries—diagnosing issues across customer setup, LangChain products, and deployment issues.

  • Work directly with engineering, operations, documentation, and product teams to resolve bugs, suggest patches, and advocate for customer needs.

  • Partner with Deployed Engineering to support critical enterprise customers.

  • Build and refine internal tooling, diagnostics, and runbooks for complex issue triage.

  • Lead post-mortems for critical incidents and feed learnings back into product and documentation.

  • Help refine KPIs for support health (MTTR, CSAT, bug recurrence) and drive continuous improvement.

  • Improve documentation and knowledge articles to improve 1-to-many resources and provide proactive support.

  • Mentor and coach other support engineers.

What You'll Bring

  • 4+ years in technical support, solutions engineering, or SRE roles in deeply technical B2B environments (e.g., observability, infrastructure, data platforms).

  • Expert troubleshooting skills across APIs, SDKs, distributed systems, and cloud-native stacks.

  • Programming experience with Python. Bonus if you have TypeScript experience.

  • Hands-on knowledge of Kubernetes and Docker

  • Comfort working with logs, traces, metrics in Datadog, and 3rd-party integrations (e.g., OpenTelemetry, LLM providers).

  • Experience supporting enterprise customers and collaborating with engineering on complex escalations.

  • A bias for clarity and continuous improvement: you write succinct, helpful, and accurate responses and build a foundation for case deflection.

You will work closely with EMEA GTM leadership and stay aligned with global Professional Services leadership. EMEA should feel like one team with the rest of PS, with the local context it needs to win.

Location: London preferred. Open to other EMEA locations with strong overlap with UK and European business hours. Some travel to customers and to our San Francisco and New York offices is expected.

What You'll Do

  • Define EMEA Customer Engineering programs: Partner with EMEA GTM leadership to design and run programs for the region. This includes onboarding, activation, enablement, and services offerings. Adapt global programs to regional needs such as data residency, regulated industries, language, and partner ecosystems.

  • Support positioning and selling: Support the creation and evolution of standard pre sales assets to support the AEs with positioning Professional Services. Work with Account Executives and Solutions Engineers on deal strategy. Help position the subscription and the right post-sale path for each customer. Join executive conversations when needed. Scope and sell Professional Services when it is the right fit. Review SOWs, estimates, and pricing for EMEA deals.

  • Own resource management and delivery: Own staffing, capacity planning, and utilization for the EMEA PS team. Match engagements to the right people and practices. Make sure delivery follows PS methodology, including scoping, technical review, documentation, and customer handoff. Review key deliverables, surface risk early, and handle escalations.

  • Lead and grow the EMEA team: Hire, onboard, coach, and develop Architects, AI Engineers, and Engagement Managers in region. Set clear expectations and give direct feedback. Build a team culture with a high bar for quality and craft.

  • Coordinate across global Customer Engineering in a matrix model: Provide day-to-day coordination and supervision for EMEA Enablement Engineers, Activation Specialists, and Account Managers.   • Align with global PS leadership: Keep delivery standards, tooling, pricing, and reporting consistent across regions. Share what works in EMEA. Bring back playbooks, reusable assets, and process improvements from the global team. Contribute to the PS operating rhythm and roadmap.

  • Run the business: Own EMEA PS bookings, utilization, delivery margin, and customer outcomes. Report on pipeline, capacity, and risk to Customer Engineering and GTM leadership.

  • Stay close to customers: Remain active in key accounts. Act as the senior escalation point for strategic EMEA customers. Be a credible voice with technical and executive stakeholders.

What You'll Bring

  • You have 10+ years of experience in professional services, solutions engineering, customer engineering, or consulting. At least 4 of those years were in leadership roles.

  • You have led a services or post-sales team in EMEA. You know the regional market and its regulatory landscape.

  • You have helped sell technical services alongside a software subscription. You can scope work, price it, and defend it with customers.

  • You have owned resource management and delivery. You understand utilization, capacity planning, and delivery quality.

  • You have led through influence in a matrix organization. You can set direction for people who do not report to you.

  • You are credible with engineers and executives. You can discuss agent architectures, cloud infrastructure, and enterprise AI adoption.

  • You have built programs from scratch in a fast-moving environment. You do not wait to be told what to do.

  • You communicate clearly and directly. You work well across time zones with a global team.

You exemplify our operating principles

  • You are motivated to build something great. You hold a high bar for quality, craft, and impact.

  • You embrace hot takes. You share informed opinions, challenge the status quo, and engage in constructive debate.

  • You operate with maximum agency. You take ownership, move work forward independently, and help others unblock.

  • You run to the roar. You lean into hard problems, ambiguity, and fast-moving challenges.

Nice to Have

  • Hands-on experience with AI/ML, LLM applications, or agent frameworks

  • Experience with SaaS subscriptions, usage-based pricing, and services attach

  • Experience working with SIs and cloud marketplaces in EMEA

  • Experience in a high-growth startup or open-source company

  • Fluency in one or more European languages in addition to English

How Success Will Be Measured

  • EMEA customers have clear programs and a connected post-sale journey.

  • Services attach rate and bookings grow in the region, with healthy margins.

  • EMEA PS meets its utilization target over time, with exceptions understood and managed.

  • Delivery consistently follows PS standards, and material risks surface early.

  • Matrix partners in Enablement, Activation, and Account Management are aligned on EMEA priorities.

  • EMEA practices stay consistent with global PS and feed improvements back to it.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the Role

You will be LangChain's dedicated cloud alliance lead for AWS, owning the relationships and revenue motions that make these partnerships produce real pipeline. This is a senior individual contributor role sitting within the Partnerships team where you'll be close to the product, close to the field, and expected to drive results without a lot of hand-holding. You'll own co-sell execution and marketplace presence end-to-end, working with cloud partner teams, field sellers, and LangChain's GTM organization to turn partner relationships into closed deals.

What You'll Do

Co-sell and pipeline

  • Own and grow LangChain's co-sell motion with AWS: manage joint pipeline, coordinate deals with AWS field teams, and drive sourced and influenced revenue.

  • Partner with LangChain sales leadership to define priority co-sell accounts, map territories to AWS coverage, and run co-sell plays region by region.

  • Keep ACE hygiene high across the sales team so that opportunity sharing, acceptance, and launch become routine rather than a partnerships-team chore.

Marketplace

  • Own LangChain's AWS Marketplace presence end to end: listings, private offers, CPPO through channel partners, and program enrollment.

  • Operate our marketplace GTM platform (Suger today) and extend referral and offer automation so sellers can transact through Marketplace without partnerships-team involvement.

Programs and funding

  • Operationalize AWS funding mechanisms across the team: MDF (market development funds for co-marketing), proof-of-concept credits, ISV Accelerate benefits, and any strategic collaboration funding we secure.

  • Pursue AWS competency and specialization programs that strengthen our positioning with AWS sellers.

  • Track funding drawn down against funding available and report it monthly.

Executive and partner relationships

  • Own LangChain's working relationships at AWS: partner development managers, ISV sales managers, Marketplace category leads, and the Bedrock and AgentCore partner teams.

  • Build executive sponsorship on both sides, and run a joint business plan with AWS that sets shared goals and a review cadence.

  • Navigate the coopetitive dynamic: partner closely with AWS on Bedrock and AgentCore while differentiating LangGraph and LangSmith where AWS has competing offerings.

Field enablement and marketing

  • Equip LangChain sales, solutions engineering, and marketing with better-together messaging, competitive positioning, and joint sales plays for AWS accounts.

  • Partner with marketing on co-branded campaigns, content, and events that generate pipeline, including re:Invent, AWS Summits, and joint customer programs.

  • Communicate results clearly to internal stakeholders, including a monthly readout on pipeline, Marketplace, and program activity.

What You'll Bring

  • 6+ years in cloud alliances, partner sales, or business development, with direct, hands-on ownership of an AWS relationship.

  • A track record of scaling a hyperscaler co-sell motion, not just starting one: you have taken a working AWS alliance to materially higher Marketplace share, pipeline, or partner-sourced revenue, and you can describe the mechanisms that got you there.

  • Deep working knowledge of AWS Marketplace transactions and programs: private offers, CPPO, ACE, ISV Accelerate, and the funding programs available to ISVs.

  • Experience operating a marketplace GTM platform such as Suger, Tackle, or WorkSpan, including referral and offer automation.

  • Experience shaping and running a joint business plan with a hyperscaler, including executive sponsorship on both sides.

  • Enough technical foundation to speak credibly with builders. You do not need to write code, but you need to understand how LangGraph, LangSmith, and LangChain fit into a customer's AWS stack.

  • Experience in a startup or high-growth environment where you set the operating rhythm for a partner motion rather than inheriting one.

  • Strong operational discipline: you manage pipeline in the CRM, track partner activity, and report results clearly to internal stakeholders.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with comfort owning senior relationships at a large cloud organization and resolving conflict constructively across company lines.

Nice to Have's

  • Prior experience inside AWS in partner sales, ISV, or Marketplace roles, with a working understanding of how co-sell decisions and seller compensation work internally.

  • Experience with commercial contracts with AWS like SCAs.

  • Existing relationships across the AWS ISV, field, Marketplace, and Bedrock partner teams.

  • Familiarity with the AI/ML ecosystem: how LLMs, agents, and developer tooling fit into enterprise stacks.

  • Experience with AWS partner programs specific to AI and data, such as the Generative AI Competency and related partner tracks.

  • Prior experience at a developer tools or infrastructure company with a product-led growth motion.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the Role

We're hiring a Regional Vice President to own and lead our APAC business. You'll inherit a team of four quota-carrying enterprise AEs across Australia, Singapore and be responsible for building the management layer, operating model, and partner ecosystem that takes APAC from early traction to consistent, scaled revenue.

This is a Director-level hire with second-line ambition. You'll report directly to the Global Vice President of Sales and operate with meaningful autonomy across pipeline, hiring, partner relationships, and executive engagement.

 

What You'll Do

Team leadership and performance

  • Lead, develop and expand the Enterprise Sales teams across the APAC region

  • Run weekly pipeline reviews, deal coaching sessions, and forecast calls with precision and consistency

  • Identify and close performance gaps early: coach the team to close larger deals faster and navigate complex, multi-stakeholder cycles

  • Build a culture of accountability and development; create clear career paths for senior individual contributors, including first-line management opportunities as the team scales

Revenue

  • Own the APAC number: quarterly and annual quota attainment across all three sub-regions

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline that supports consistent delivery and predictable forecasting to Global VP of Sales and leadership

  • Engage directly in strategic deals as executive sponsor, bringing credibility and commercial weight to enterprise negotiations

  • Establish the region's strongest lighthouse accounts across key industry verticals, building referenceable wins that anchor LangChain's market position in APAC

Hiring

  • Manage multiple open roles across APAC simultaneously: owning the full hiring lifecycle across pipeline, assessment, and closing

  • Partner with the internal talent team to move at pace without compromising on quality

  • Define the headcount profile for APAC beyond Q4 and feed into H1 planning, ensuring the team is built ahead of the revenue curve

Partner ecosystem

  • Owns hyperscaler and GSI/RSI relationships (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, and key SIs) across APAC

  • Develop a structured partner motion that generates qualified pipeline and supports deal acceleration, reduces risk and drives expansion

  • Represent LangChain at partner QBRs and executive engagements in region

Market presence

  • Represent LangChain as a keynote-ready leader at partner events, customer engagements, and industry conferences across the region

  • Build LangChain's brand with technical buyers, CIOs, and innovation leaders across APAC's most important enterprise accounts

  • Bring intelligence on the APAC markets back to the Global VP of Sales and product teams to inform roadmap and go-to-market positioning

 

What You’ll Bring

Experience

  • 8+ years in enterprise SaaS sales, with at least 3 years in a regional or sub-regional leadership role managing quota-carrying AEs

  • Demonstrable track record of hitting and exceeding regional revenue targets across multiple quarters

  • Experience managing teams across multiple countries and time zones, with the cultural intelligence to operate across the APAC region

  • Background selling to technical buyers (engineering leaders, CTOs, platform teams): you understand how developer tools get evaluated and adopted

  • Experience in the AI, data, or developer tooling space strongly preferred; familiarity with the LangChain ecosystem is a meaningful plus

Leadership

  • You've run teams of 6+ AEs before and know the difference between managing and coaching

  • You can hold a forecast conversation with a VP and a deal coaching session with an AE in the same afternoon, and add value in both

  • You hire well and fast. You know what good looks like for enterprise AE profiles and you can run structured hiring processes across four open roles simultaneously

  • You've built or contributed to a partner motion before: you understand what "partner pipeline" means in practice, not just in theory

Operating style

  • You bias toward action. You don't wait for a playbook to be handed to you: you build it

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage scale. This is not a role with a fully defined motion; you'll shape a significant part of it

  • You communicate clearly and directly, to your team and to leadership

  • You're present in the market. You attend the right events, know the right people, and build relationships that translate into pipeline and retention

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Experience

 - 8+ years in enterprise SaaS sales, with at least 3 years in a regional or sub-regional leadership role managing quota-carrying AEs

 - Demonstrable track record of hitting and exceeding regional revenue targets across multiple quarters

 - Experience managing teams across multiple countries and time zones, with the cultural intelligence to operate across the APAC region

 - Background selling to technical buyers (engineering leaders, CTOs, platform teams): you understand how developer tools get evaluated and adopted

 - Experience in the AI, data, or developer tooling space strongly preferred; familiarity with the LangChain ecosystem is a meaningful plus

Leadership

 - You've run teams of 6+ AEs before and know the difference between managing and coaching

 - You can hold a forecast conversation with a VP and a deal coaching session with an AE in the same afternoon, and add value in both

 - You hire well and fast. You know what good looks like for enterprise AE profiles and you can run structured hiring processes across four open roles simultaneously

 - You've built or contributed to a partner motion before: you understand what "partner pipeline" means in practice, not just in theory

 - You bias toward action. You don't wait for a playbook to be handed to you: you build it

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage scale. This is not a role with a fully defined motion; you'll shape a significant part of it

 - You communicate clearly and directly, to your team and to leadership

 - You're present in the market. You attend the right events, know the right people, and build relationships that translate into pipeline and retention 




COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

You will be LangChain's dedicated cloud alliance lead for AWS, owning the relationships and revenue motions that make these partnerships produce real pipeline. This is a senior individual contributor role sitting within the Partnerships team where you'll be close to the product, close to the field, and expected to drive results without a lot of hand-holding. You'll own co-sell execution and marketplace presence end-to-end, working with cloud partner teams, field sellers, and LangChain's GTM organization to turn partner relationships into closed deals.

What You'll Do

Co-sell and pipeline

  • Own and grow LangChain's co-sell motion with AWS: manage joint pipeline, coordinate deals with AWS field teams, and drive sourced and influenced revenue.

  • Partner with LangChain sales leadership to define priority co-sell accounts, map territories to AWS coverage, and run co-sell plays region by region.

  • Keep ACE hygiene high across the sales team so that opportunity sharing, acceptance, and launch become routine rather than a partnerships-team chore.

Marketplace

  • Own LangChain's AWS Marketplace presence end to end: listings, private offers, CPPO through channel partners, and program enrollment.

  • Operate our marketplace GTM platform (Suger today) and extend referral and offer automation so sellers can transact through Marketplace without partnerships-team involvement.

Programs and funding

  • Operationalize AWS funding mechanisms across the team: MDF (market development funds for co-marketing), proof-of-concept credits, ISV Accelerate benefits, and any strategic collaboration funding we secure.

  • Pursue AWS competency and specialization programs that strengthen our positioning with AWS sellers.

  • Track funding drawn down against funding available and report it monthly.

Executive and partner relationships

  • Own LangChain's working relationships at AWS: partner development managers, ISV sales managers, Marketplace category leads, and the Bedrock and AgentCore partner teams.

  • Build executive sponsorship on both sides, and run a joint business plan with AWS that sets shared goals and a review cadence.

  • Navigate the coopetitive dynamic: partner closely with AWS on Bedrock and AgentCore while differentiating LangGraph and LangSmith where AWS has competing offerings.

Field enablement and marketing

  • Equip LangChain sales, solutions engineering, and marketing with better-together messaging, competitive positioning, and joint sales plays for AWS accounts.

  • Partner with marketing on co-branded campaigns, content, and events that generate pipeline, including re:Invent, AWS Summits, and joint customer programs.

  • Communicate results clearly to internal stakeholders, including a monthly readout on pipeline, Marketplace, and program activity.

What You'll Bring

  • 6+ years in cloud alliances, partner sales, or business development, with direct, hands-on ownership of an AWS relationship.

  • A track record of scaling a hyperscaler co-sell motion, not just starting one: you have taken a working AWS alliance to materially higher Marketplace share, pipeline, or partner-sourced revenue, and you can describe the mechanisms that got you there.

  • Deep working knowledge of AWS Marketplace transactions and programs: private offers, CPPO, ACE, ISV Accelerate, and the funding programs available to ISVs.

  • Experience operating a marketplace GTM platform such as Suger, Tackle, or WorkSpan, including referral and offer automation.

  • Experience shaping and running a joint business plan with a hyperscaler, including executive sponsorship on both sides.

  • Enough technical foundation to speak credibly with builders. You do not need to write code, but you need to understand how LangGraph, LangSmith, and LangChain fit into a customer's AWS stack.

  • Experience in a startup or high-growth environment where you set the operating rhythm for a partner motion rather than inheriting one.

  • Strong operational discipline: you manage pipeline in the CRM, track partner activity, and report results clearly to internal stakeholders.

  • Excellent communication and relationship-building skills, with comfort owning senior relationships at a large cloud organization and resolving conflict constructively across company lines.

Nice to Have's

  • Prior experience inside AWS in partner sales, ISV, or Marketplace roles, with a working understanding of how co-sell decisions and seller compensation work internally.

  • Experience with commercial contracts with AWS like SCAs.

  • Existing relationships across the AWS ISV, field, Marketplace, and Bedrock partner teams.

  • Familiarity with the AI/ML ecosystem: how LLMs, agents, and developer tooling fit into enterprise stacks.

  • Experience with AWS partner programs specific to AI and data, such as the Generative AI Competency and related partner tracks.

  • Prior experience at a developer tools or infrastructure company with a product-led growth motion.

Annual salary range: $200,000 - $250,000 OTE + Equity

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

ABOUT THE ROLE

We're hiring a Vice President to own and lead our EMEA business. You'll inherit a team of 20+ quota-carrying Commercial and Enterprise AE's across four hubs: London, Amsterdam, Munich, Stockholm and be responsible for building the management layer, operating model and partner ecosystem that takes the EMEA region from early traction to consistent, scaled revenue.

This is a second-line leader role that will see you report directly to the Global Vice President of Sales and operate with meaningful autonomy across pipeline, hiring, partner relationships and executive engagement.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

Team leadership and performance

 - Lead, develop and expand the Sales teams across EMEA from day one

 - Run weekly pipeline reviews, deal coaching sessions, and forecast calls with precision and consistency

 - Identify and close performance gaps early: coach the team to close larger deals faster and navigate complex, multi-stakeholder cycles

 - Build a culture of accountability and development; create clear career paths for senior individual contributors, including first-line management opportunities as the team scales

Revenue

 - Own the EMEA number: quarterly and annual quota attainment across all sub-regions

 - Build and maintain a healthy pipeline that supports consistent delivery and predictable forecasting to leadership

 - Engage directly in strategic deals as executive sponsor, bringing credibility and commercial weight to enterprise negotiations

 - Establish the region's strongest lighthouse accounts across key industry verticals, building referenceable wins that anchor LangChain's market position in EMEA

Hiring

 - Manage multiple open roles across EMEA simultaneously: owning the full hiring lifecycle across pipeline, assessment and closing

 - Partner with the internal talent team to move at pace without compromising on quality

 - Define the headcount profile for EMEA beyond Q4 and feed into H1 planning, ensuring the team is built ahead of the revenue curve

Partner ecosystem

 - Owns hyperscaler and GSI/RSI relationships (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, and key SIs) across EMEA

 - Develop a structured partner motion that generates qualified pipeline and supports deal acceleration, reduces risk and drives expansion

 - Represent LangChain at partner QBRs and executive engagements in region

Market presence

 - Represent LangChain as a keynote-ready leader at partner events, customer engagements, and industry conferences across the region: including KubeCon, Money20/20, Nordic AI summits, and customer EBCs

 - Build LangChain's brand with technical buyers, CIOs, and innovation leaders across Northern Europe's most important enterprise accounts

 - Bring intelligence on the EMEA markets back to the Global VP of Sales and product teams to inform roadmap and go-to-market positioning




WHAT YOU’LL BRING

Experience

 - 10+ years in enterprise SaaS sales, with at least 5+ years in a regional or sub-regional leadership role managing quota-carrying AE's

 - Demonstrable track record of hitting and exceeding regional revenue targets across multiple quarters

 - Experience managing teams across multiple countries and time zones, with the cultural intelligence to operate across EMEA

 - Background selling to technical buyers (engineering leaders, CTOs, platform teams): you understand how developer tools get evaluated and adopted

 - Experience in the AI, data, or developer tooling space strongly preferred; familiarity with the LangChain ecosystem is a meaningful plus

Leadership

 - You've run teams of 20+ AEs before and know the difference between managing and coaching

 - You can hold a forecast conversation with a VP and a deal coaching session with an AE in the same afternoon and add value in both

 - You hire well and fast. You know what good looks like for enterprise AE profiles and you can run structured hiring processes across four open roles simultaneously

 - You've built or contributed to a partner motion before: you understand what "partner pipeline" means in practice, not just in theory

Operating style

 - You bias toward action. You don't wait for a playbook to be handed to you: you build it

 - You're comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage scale. This is not a role with a fully defined motion; you'll shape a significant part of it

 - You communicate clearly and directly, to your team and to leadership

 - You're present in the market. You attend the right events, know the right people and build relationships that translate into pipeline and retention




COMPENSATION PHILOSOPHY

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks. 

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.




BENEFITS

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the Role

We're hiring an Integrated Campaigns Manager to own how LangChain brings our biggest narratives to market through integrated, multi-channel campaigns and webinars programs that generate awareness, engagement, and pipeline globally.

You'll partner closely with Product Marketing, Solutions, Industry Marketing, and Thought Leadership to translate messaging, customer stories, and content into full-funnel campaigns. From defining the campaign strategy and channel mix to building landing pages, launching webinars, coordinating promotion, and optimizing conversions, you'll own execution from start to finish.

You'll be responsible for connecting the dots across channels, audiences, and regions, ensuring we're not just launching individual tactics but building cohesive campaigns that move prospects through the funnel.

We're looking for someone who is equally comfortable developing a campaign strategy and getting into the details of execution. You should know how to turn an idea into a live campaign, measure what's working, and continuously optimize to drive pipeline.

What You'll Do

Global integrated campaign strategy and pipeline

  • Build and own global integrated campaign plans across our core product, solutions, industry, and thought leadership narratives.

  • Partner with Product Marketing, Solutions, Industry Marketing, and Thought Leadership to translate positioning and content into campaigns with clear audiences, messaging, channels, and conversion goals.

  • Develop full-funnel campaign strategies that connect awareness and education to demand capture and pipeline generation.

  • Define campaign goals, audience segmentation, channel investments, and success metrics, with accountability for campaign-sourced and influenced pipeline.

  • Partner with regional demand generation and field marketing teams to adapt global campaigns for NAMER, EMEA, and APAC markets.

  • Build repeatable campaign playbooks and identify opportunities to scale successful programs across regions.

End-to-end campaign execution

You'll own the campaign from initial concept through launch, optimization, and reporting, and be hands-on throughout.

  • Integrated campaigns: Build and execute multi-channel campaigns across email, paid media, organic social, webinars, third-party promotion, and sales outreach.

  • Webinars and virtual programs: Own end-to-end webinar execution, including programming strategy, speaker coordination, promotional planning, registration and attendance optimization, and post-event follow-up. Programs may include thought leadership webinars, product education, live demos, and industry-specific sessions.

  • Campaign assets and landing pages: Partner with content, design, and web teams to develop campaign assets and landing pages, ensuring consistent messaging and compelling conversion paths.

  • Lifecycle: Partner with lifecycle marketing to develop segmented nurture programs, audience journeys, and follow-up campaigns that move prospects from initial engagement toward sales opportunities.

  • Paid and digital: Partner with performance marketing on audience targeting, paid promotion, retargeting, campaign creative, and conversion strategies.

  • Sales activation: Build campaign enablement and outreach plays with sales and SDR teams to turn engagement into meetings and opportunities.

Conversion optimization and campaign performance

  • Own campaign conversion performance across landing pages, webinar registrations, content downloads, and other campaign conversion points.

  • Identify friction across the customer journey and develop experiments to improve conversion rates and lead quality.

  • Optimize campaign messaging, creative, targeting, offers, and CTAs based on performance.

  • Track campaign effectiveness across engagement, MQLs, meetings, opportunities, and pipeline.

  • Partner with Marketing Ops to ensure proper campaign tracking, attribution, and reporting.

  • Translate performance insights into recommendations on where to invest, what to improve, and what to scale.

Cross-functional partnership

  • Work directly with Product Marketing and content marketing to understand product positioning, launches, and messaging priorities and translate them into global campaign strategies.

  • Identify compelling narratives, customer proof points, and campaign opportunities with cross-functional partners.

  • Partner with regional and field marketing teams to ensure global campaigns are relevant to local audiences and sales priorities.

  • Work closely with Performance Marketing, Lifecycle, and Marketing Ops to build coordinated programs across channels.

  • Collaborate with Sales and SDR teams on campaign activation, account targeting, and follow-up strategies that drive pipeline.

  • Own campaign planning, timelines, stakeholder alignment, and execution to ensure campaigns launch successfully.

What You'll Bring

  • 5–11+ years of experience in B2B demand generation, integrated campaigns, or growth marketing, ideally in developer tools, infrastructure, AI, or technical SaaS.

  • Proven experience building and executing multi-channel integrated campaigns, with measurable pipeline or revenue outcomes.

  • You've personally built and launched campaigns, including landing pages, email programs, webinars, promotional plans, and nurture journeys.

  • Strong understanding of full-funnel campaign strategy, audience segmentation, channel orchestration, and conversion optimization.

  • Experience running end-to-end webinar and virtual event programs, from planning and promotion to follow-up and performance analysis.

  • You're comfortable translating technical product messaging and thought leadership into campaigns that resonate with both technical practitioners and enterprise decision-makers.

  • Strong analytical skills and fluency in funnel conversion, MQLs, cost per opportunity, campaign attribution, and pipeline contribution.

  • Experience working across global and regional marketing teams, balancing consistent campaign messaging with local market needs.

  • Working knowledge of modern marketing tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Goldcast, Zoom Webinar, and Google Analytics.

  • Strong project management skills with the ability to coordinate multiple stakeholders, prioritize competing initiatives, and launch campaigns on schedule.

  • You're a builder. You can develop the strategy, write the copy, build the landing page, launch the campaign, pull the report, and optimize based on the results.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity, fast-moving environments, and true end-to-end ownership.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

jobs.title: Performance Marketing Manager, Paid Search & AI Advertising
jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. Our open-source harnesses and LangSmith platform give developers and enterprises the infrastructure to run, improve, and govern agents at scale.

We've raised $460M to date, with our most recent funding round valuing the company at $3B, backed by leading investors including Sequoia, Benchmark, IVP, and CapitalG. As we continue to expand our platform and tackle some of the hardest challenges in agent engineering, every team member has the opportunity to make a meaningful impact and help shape both our technology and the future of the industry.

More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the Role

We're hiring an experienced Performance Marketer to own and scale paid search and emerging AI advertising channels at LangChain, starting with Google Ads, Bing (Microsoft Advertising), and ChatGPT.

You'll own the entire paid acquisition experience, from developing channel strategy and building campaigns to optimizing landing pages, improving conversion rates, and driving qualified pipeline.

This is a highly hands-on role. You'll be the person building campaigns, analyzing performance, testing creative, improving landing pages, and identifying new opportunities to scale.

We're looking for someone who combines deep paid search expertise with a willingness to experiment with emerging advertising platforms. You should be comfortable managing significant budgets, making data-driven investment decisions, and connecting advertising performance to downstream pipeline rather than just clicks, leads, or conversions.

What You'll Do

Paid acquisition strategy and pipeline

  • Own the strategy across Google Ads, Bing, and ChatGPT advertising, with the opportunity to expand into additional AI-native advertising channels.

  • Develop channel-specific strategies based on audience intent, available targeting capabilities, and expected pipeline contribution.

  • Own budget allocation, forecasting, and performance against pipeline targets.

  • Balance investment across branded, non-branded, competitor, and product-specific campaigns, along with emerging AI advertising opportunities.

  • Identify opportunities to scale high-performing campaigns and build repeatable playbooks for new channels.

  • Develop testing roadmaps across audiences, messaging, bidding, conversion experiences, and new advertising formats.

End-to-end campaign execution

You'll own campaign execution across all three channels:

  • Google Ads: Build, launch, and manage campaigns across branded, non-branded, competitor, and product search, including keyword research, match types, negative keywords, bidding, and budget optimization.

  • Bing / Microsoft Advertising: Develop and manage campaigns tailored to Microsoft's search audience, identifying opportunities to extend reach and capture incremental high-intent demand.

  • ChatGPT advertising: Develop and execute an early advertising strategy, testing available placements, audience approaches, messaging, and conversion experiences as the platform evolves.

  • Creative and messaging: Write and test ad copy in partnership with Product Marketing, adapting messaging to each channel and its user intent.

  • Experimentation: Run structured tests to improve acquisition efficiency, traffic quality, and pipeline conversion.

  • Campaign operations: Own campaign setup, tracking validation, launch readiness, troubleshooting, and day-to-day optimization.

Paid conversion experience and website optimization

  • Own the website conversion experience for traffic acquired through Google, Bing, and ChatGPT.

  • Build and optimize dedicated landing pages for paid acquisition campaigns using Webflow or similar tools.

  • Develop and execute A/B tests across landing page messaging, layouts, CTAs, and forms.

  • Identify friction across the full user journey, from ad interaction to product sign-up, demo request, or meeting booking.

  • Optimize conversion paths for both developers exploring LangSmith and enterprise buyers evaluating commercial solutions.

  • Partner with Marketing Operations to improve form conversion, qualification, routing, and meeting booking.

  • Ensure landing page experiences reflect the user's intent and context across different advertising channels.

Measurement, reporting, and optimization

  • Own performance reporting across spend, traffic, conversions, qualified leads, meetings, opportunities, and pipeline.

  • Develop channel-specific measurement frameworks for Google Ads, Bing, and ChatGPT based on their available reporting and conversion capabilities.

  • Partner with Marketing Operations to connect advertising conversion signals with HubSpot and Salesforce data.

  • Optimize established search channels toward downstream pipeline signals, including offline conversion tracking where supported.

  • Establish a testing and measurement approach for emerging channels where attribution and optimization capabilities may be less mature.

  • Analyze performance across channels, audiences, campaigns, and landing pages to identify where to invest, optimize, or reduce spend.

Cross-functional partnership

  • Partner with Product Marketing to translate positioning into search campaigns, AI advertising messaging, and landing page experiences.

  • Work closely with Web and Design on landing page development and conversion experimentation.

  • Collaborate with Marketing Operations on tracking, attribution, CRM integrations, and reporting accuracy.

  • Align with Demand Generation on product launches, campaign priorities, budget allocation, and pipeline targets.

What You'll Bring

  • 5–11 years in performance marketing, paid search, or B2B growth marketing, ideally in developer tools, infrastructure, or technical SaaS.

  • Deep hands-on expertise in Google Ads and experience managing Microsoft Advertising.

  • Proven experience personally building, launching, and optimizing paid search campaigns.

  • Strong understanding of campaign architecture, keyword intent, bidding strategies, negative keywords, and search budget optimization.

  • Experience testing new advertising platforms or emerging acquisition channels. Curiosity about AI-native search and advertising is important.

  • Strong experience with conversion rate optimization, landing page development, and A/B testing.

  • Experience managing meaningful budgets and optimizing toward qualified pipeline and revenue outcomes.

  • Strong analytical skills and fluency in CPC, CVR, CPL, cost per opportunity, pipeline contribution, and attribution.

  • Working knowledge of Google Ads, Microsoft Advertising, GA4, Google Tag Manager, HubSpot, Salesforce, and Flint/Webflow.

  • Comfortable with technical products and developer audiences.

  • A strong experimentation mindset and willingness to build new programs without an established playbook.

  • Comfortable with ambiguity and true ownership.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

About the Role

The Customer Experience team helps customers adopt LangSmith and turn early momentum into lasting product usage. The team partners closely with GTM, Product, Engineering, and LangChain specialists to guide customers through onboarding, production readiness, and the practices required to build reliable AI applications.

We’re looking for an Activation Specialist to join the Customer Experience team. In this role, you’ll work with new customers during their first weeks on LangSmith, helping them move from signed contract to a working platform that is ready for agents in production. You’ll focus on activation milestones such as admin setup, user onboarding, traces flowing, evaluations in place, and customer teams feeling confident enough to keep building independently.

What You’ll Do

  • Own customer onboarding from kickoff through early activation milestones, including admin setup, SDK integration, first traced run, first evaluation, and LangGraph deployment.

  • Guide customers through core LangSmith setup and production readiness topics, including security, org design, workload isolation, and integration questions.

  • Partner with GTM teams, Product, Engineering, and LangChain specialists to unblock customers and coordinate support when deeper expertise is needed.

  • Help customers build their first evaluation workflows, define what “good” looks like, and confirm they can debug a production trace independently.

  • Route customers to the right resources and turn recurring onboarding questions into runbooks, documentation, and repeatable processes.

  • Surface customer friction to Product and Engineering early and track activation metrics such as time to first trace, first evaluation, and production run.

What You’ll Bring

  • 2–4 years of experience in a customer-facing role such as support, customer success, account management, onboarding, or a similar function.

  • A strong desire to work directly with customers and build productive, trusted relationships.

  • Excellent organization and follow-through, with a track record of keeping customers and internal partners aligned.

  • A proactive, industrious approach to learning new tools, solving problems, and rolling up your sleeves.

  • Clear, friendly written and verbal communication skills.

  • Curiosity about technology and AI, plus a willingness to get hands-on and learn technical concepts on the job.

Nice to Have’s

  • Customer onboarding experience at a SaaS company.

  • Familiarity with enterprise readiness concepts such as SSO, SCIM, ABAC, and workload isolation.

  • Exposure to developer tools, observability, evaluations, or AI/LLM workflows.

  • Familiarity with analytics, BI tools or SQL.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

The Professional Services team is the bridge between LangChain's technology and the enterprise customers building on top of it. We partner with some of the world's most ambitious companies to help them move from pilot to production — designing solutions, accelerating time-to-value, and ensuring teams get the most out of LangChain, LangGraph, and LangSmith. We work at the intersection of deep technical expertise and customer partnership, and we take pride in the outcomes our customers achieve. As LangChain grows, PS plays a direct role in shaping how enterprise AI gets built in the real world.

We're looking for an Engagement Manager to join our Professional Services team. You'll manage multiple concurrent technical engagements, ensuring successful delivery of Professional Services projects for enterprise customers. You'll be the primary point of contact for customers and coordinate cross-functional teams to deliver exceptional outcomes.

This role offers direct impact on customer success, the opportunity to shape processes and methodologies, and the chance to work with cutting-edge AI technology. You'll join a collaborative team environment with a strong engineering culture.

What You'll Do

  • Engagement Lifecycle Management: Manage the full engagement lifecycle from SOW review through closeout, including planning, execution, risk management, scope management, and handoff

  • Customer Communication & Relationship Management: Serve as the primary point of contact for customers — deliver status updates, manage expectations, handle escalations, and negotiate scope changes

  • Multi-Engagement Management: Manage 5–8 concurrent technical engagements simultaneously while maintaining quality and meeting deadlines

  • Cross-Functional Coordination: Coordinate with Solution Architects, AI Engineers, Sales, Support, Enablement, and Product/Engineering teams; manage resource allocation and capacity planning

  • Risk & Issue Management: Proactively identify risks and issues, develop mitigation strategies, track resolution, and ensure deliverables meet quality standards

What You'll Bring

  • You have 5+ years of engagement or project management experience, preferably with technical or software engagements

  • You've managed multiple concurrent engagements and know how to keep quality high across all of them

  • You have strong experience working with enterprise customers and leading customer-facing communication

  • You've coordinated cross-functional technical teams — engineers, architects, product — and managed resource allocation

  • You're experienced with project management tools such as Linear, Jira, Asana, or similar

  • You've handled scope change management and complex stakeholder dynamics

  • You have start-up DNA: you thrive in fast-paced, ambiguous environments and don't wait to be told what to do

  • You're a natural communicator — clear, direct, and effective with both technical teams and executive stakeholders

You exemplify our operating principles

  • You are motivated to build something great: you hold a high bar for quality, craft, and impact

  • You embrace hot takes: you share informed opinions, challenge the status quo, and engage in constructive debate

  • You operate with maximum agency: you take ownership, move work forward independently, and help others unblock

  • You run to the roar: you lean into hard problems, ambiguity, and fast-moving challenges

Nice to Have

  • PMP or similar project management certification

  • Experience in Professional Services or consulting

  • Experience with AI/ML or infrastructure engagements

  • Experience with time tracking and billing coordination

  • Knowledge of software development lifecycle and agile methodologies

About The Role

As the Sales Engineering Manager for Northern Europe, you will lead a team of sales engineers from our hub in Amsterdam, working with our customers across DACH and Benelux. You'll help build and shape the team, grow the people in it and make sure our customers get the technical partnership they need to build and run great agents in production. This is an opportunity to have outsized impact at a company shaping the future of AI-powered software.

DEs work alongside our sales team to help our prospects and customers build reliable, scalable agents for their business using our suite of products: LangChain, LangGraph, Deep Agents and LangSmith. The team focuses on pre-sales efforts, but stays on accounts to not only close new business but also to make our customers wildly successful.

Your first job is your people. You will support great sales engineers, ramp them quickly, coach them through live customer work and build a team where they do the best work of their careers. You'll stay close enough to the technology and to our customers to be credible with both: unblocking your team on hard engagements and stepping in on the region's most important opportunities.

You will report to the Director of Deployed Engineering, EMEA and partner closely with LangChain's sales leaders covering DACH and Benelux, with shared ownership of regional outcomes.

This role is mostly people leadership, with real customer engagement and revenue accountability alongside it. As part of the EMEA deployed engineering leadership team, you'll also bring what you learn back into the playbooks, processes and standards we use globally.

What You'll Do

  • Grow the DACH/Benelux DE team: support recruiting, interviewing and closing candidates as the team grows and raise the bar with every hire.

  • Onboard and ramp new DEs quickly, with a clear definition of what "ramped" looks like and the support to get each person there.

  • Coach your team through live customer work: join calls, review architectures and proofs of value to provide direct, specific feedback that makes people better.

  • Own performance management: set clear expectations, recognise great work and address underperformance early and fairly.

  • Run the team's operating rhythm: account coverage, capacity and load balancing, deal and engagement reviews and the regional cadence with sales.

  • Partner with sales leadership in DACH and the Benelux on account strategy, coverage and technical win plans, with shared accountability for revenue outcomes and customer success.

  • Bring regional insight to the global DE team: what's working with customers in the region, product feedback and contributions to shared playbooks.

  • Develop future leaders, growing the senior DEs who will lead the next teams in the region.


What You’ll Bring

  • 7+ years of experience in sales engineering, solutions architecture, engineering, or similar customer-facing technical roles at a dev tools, AI, or infrastructure company.

  • 2+ years managing customer-facing engineers, including hiring, coaching and performance management.

  • A track record of developing people: engineers you hired and grew who went on to bigger scope or roles.

  • Technical credibility with your team and your customers: you're not a stranger to Python, and are well-versed in software engineering, platform engineering and solutions architecture. Hands-on experience building with LLMs or agents is a strong plus.

  • Experience working with or selling to developers and engineering-led buyers and an understanding of how enterprises in the region evaluate and buy (procurement, data protection, hosting and sovereignty requirements).

  • Exceptional communication and technical storytelling skills, with the ability to simplify complex concepts for customers and coach others to do the same.

  • A bias for action, comfort with ambiguity and a consistently high bar for excellence.

  • Fluent English; German strongly preferred.

  • Must be available to work in Amsterdam, with regular travel across the region.

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.

jobs.descriptionHtml:
About Us

At LangChain, our mission is to enable every company to own its intelligence. We believe agents will transform how companies operate, and we're building the foundation to make that future possible. More than 7,000 organizations rely on LangSmith, from fast-growing startups to Fortune 500 enterprises, including NVIDIA, Bridgewater, LinkedIn, Workday, and Rippling. We're just getting started on making high-performing agents easier to build and manage at scale.

About the Role

We're hiring a Regional Vice President within EMEA to own and lead our DACH business. You'll inherit a team of two quota-carrying enterprise AEs across the region and be responsible for building the management layer, operating model and partner ecosystem that takes DACH from early traction to consistent, scaled revenue.

This is a Director-level hire with second-line ambition. You'll report directly to the VP EMEA and operate with meaningful autonomy across pipeline, hiring, partner relationships and executive engagement.

 

What You'll Do

Team leadership and performance

  • Lead, develop and expand the Enterprise Sales teams across DACH from day one

  • Run weekly pipeline reviews, deal coaching sessions and forecast calls with precision and consistency

  • Identify and close performance gaps early: coach the team to close larger deals faster and navigate complex, multi-stakeholder cycles

  • Build a culture of accountability and development; create clear career paths for senior individual contributors, including first-line management opportunities as the team scales

Revenue

  • Own the DACH regional number: quarterly and annual quota attainment across all three sub-regions

  • Build and maintain a healthy pipeline that supports consistent delivery and predictable forecasting to VP EMEA and leadership

  • Engage directly in strategic deals as executive sponsor, bringing credibility and commercial weight to enterprise negotiations

  • Establish the region's strongest lighthouse accounts across key industry verticals, building referenceable wins that anchor LangChain's market position in DACH

Hiring

  • Manage multiple open roles across DACH simultaneously: owning the full hiring lifecycle across pipeline, assessment and closing

  • Partner with the retained search firm and internal talent team to move at pace without compromising on quality

  • Define the headcount profile for DACH beyond Q1 and feed into H2 planning, ensuring the team is built ahead of the revenue curve

Partner ecosystem

  • Owns hyperscaler and GSI/RSI relationships (AWS, Google Cloud, Azure, and key SIs) across DACH

  • Develop a structured partner motion that generates qualified pipeline and supports deal acceleration, reduces risk and drives expansion

  • Represent LangChain at partner QBRs and executive engagements in region

Market presence

  • Represent LangChain as a keynote-ready leader at partner events, customer engagements, and industry conferences across the region

  • Build LangChain's brand with technical buyers, CIOs, and innovation leaders across DACH's most important enterprise accounts

  • Bring intelligence on the DACH market back to the VP EMEA and product teams to inform roadmap and go-to-market positioning

 

What You’ll Bring

Experience

  • 8+ years in enterprise SaaS sales, with at least 3 years in a regional or sub-regional leadership role managing quota-carrying AEs

  • Demonstrable track record of hitting and exceeding regional revenue targets across multiple quarters

  • Experience managing teams across multiple countries and time zones, with the cultural intelligence to operate across the DACH region

  • Background selling to technical buyers (engineering leaders, CTOs, platform teams): you understand how developer tools get evaluated and adopted

  • Experience in the AI, data, or developer tooling space strongly preferred; familiarity with the LangChain ecosystem is a meaningful plus

Leadership

  • You've run teams of 6+ AEs before and know the difference between managing and coaching

  • You can hold a forecast conversation with a VP and a deal coaching session with an AE in the same afternoon and add value in both

  • You hire well and fast. You know what good looks like for enterprise AE profiles and you can run structured hiring processes across four open roles simultaneously

  • You've built or contributed to a partner motion before: you understand what "partner pipeline" means in practice, not just in theory

Operating style

  • You bias toward action. You don't wait for a playbook to be handed to you: you build it

  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and early-stage scale. This is not a role with a fully defined motion; you'll shape a significant part of it

  • You communicate clearly and directly, to your team and to leadership

  • You're present in the market. You attend the right events, know the right people, and build relationships that translate into pipeline and retention

Compensation Philosophy

We offer competitive compensation that includes base salary, variable compensation for relevant roles, meaningful equity, benefits, and perks.

We are hiring for this role across a range of scope, and the compensation band reflects that. Your offer depends on what we learn about your impact, craft, leadership, and communication during the interview process. We will tell you early where you’re tracking and talk comp with you before offer stage. Team members in the EU, UK, and APAC receive locally competitive benefits aligned with regional norms and regulations.

Benefits

Benefits include medical, dental, and vision coverage, flexible vacation, a 401(k) plan, meals on in-office days in the US and more.
